name: icerden-bakan-goz

styleBlock.medium: Analog-feeling still image of a lived-in apartment interior, as if shot on high-ISO film at night; static medium shot from inside the room, looking at a corner, a wall or a window, never from outdoors; soft optical bloom around the single warm light, slight lens softness, no crisp digital sharpness.
styleBlock.lines: Soft, slightly smeared edges with no vector outlines; forms read as large simple masses; gentle halation where warm light meets dark surfaces.

palette.role: the single warm light source, amber core
soft warm highlight on nearby surfaces lit by that source
warm wood and fabric tone, only inside the warm pool
deep cool blue-slate shadow, never pure black
dusty grey-blue for walls and window glass outside the warm pool
pale cool haze for rain, steam and dawn sky

styleBlock.light: Exactly one warm light source in the frame (lamp, stove, hood light, screen or street lamp) casting a single warm pool; everything outside that pool falls into cool blue-grey shadow. The hue of the source may shift with the season, the logic never changes: one warm point, cool surroundings.
styleBlock.texture: Medium-to-high film grain across the whole frame, slight analog softness, faint dust; no clean digital gradients.
styleBlock.contrast: Medium-high local contrast around the warm pool, low contrast elsewhere; shadows stay cool and never fully close; the warm point stays readable even when the frame is shrunk to thumbnail size.
styleBlock.shading: Soft falloff from the warm source, cool tinted shadows, no hard-edged cast shadows, no second rim light.

motionHints: the single warm light source flickering gently
rain trails sliding down a window pane
steam rising slowly from a kettle or cup
a curtain swaying faintly in a draft
